explication: Plain Craft Launcher is a Windows desktop Minecraft launcher. Its main user journey is selecting or configuring an instance, obtaining Minecraft or community resources, choosing a Java runtime, and launching the game. The README identifies UI, animation, download, and Minecraft-launch modules; the tree also shows instance management, login, and settings features. Sampled source confirms Java discovery/configuration and install-manifest behavior. Other subsystem links are shown as unverified because their implementation was not sampled.
